1: // Game: Asteroid Dodge
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: // The ship moves with arrow keys and must avoid asteroids that spawn from the right.
4: // Score = seconds survived, displayed in the top‑left corner.
5: 
6: (() => {
7:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
8:   if (!canvas) {
9:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
10:     return;
11:   }
12:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
13:   // audio context for simple sounds
14:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
15:   function playBeep(freq, duration) {
16:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
17:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
18:     osc.type = 'sine';
19:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
20:     osc.connect(gain);
21:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
22:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
23:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
24:     osc.start();
25:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
26:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
27:   }
28:   // Ensure canvas fills its container (or use its intrinsic size)
29:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
30:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 400;
31:   // background gradient (space nebula)
32:   const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
33:   bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#02070a');
34:   bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1a0033');
35:   // create starfield
36:   const stars = [];
37:   const starCount = 100;
38:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
39:     stars.push({
40:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
41:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
42:       r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
43:       speed: 20 + Math.random() * 30
44:     });
45:   }
46: 
47:   // ---- Game objects ----
48:   const ship = {
49:   // ship defined; stars will be generated globally
50: 
51:     x: 80,
52:     y: canvas.height / 2,
53:     radius: 12,
54:     speed: 200 // pixels per second
55:   };
56: 
57:   class Asteroid {
58:     constructor() {
59:       this.x = canvas.width + Math.random() * 100;
60:       this.y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
61:       this.r = 15 + Math.random() * 20;
62:       this.speed = 100 + Math.random() * 100; // leftward speed
63:     }
64:     update(dt) {
65:       this.x -= this.speed * dt;
66:     }
67:     isOffScreen() {
68:       return this.x + this.r < 0;
69:     }
70: draw() { // draw asteroid with gradient
71:     const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(this.x, this.y, this.r*0.2, this.x, this.y, this.r);
72:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#aaa');
73:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#444');
74:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
75:       //     // ctx.fillStyle = '#666'; // gradient already set
76:       ctx.beginPath();
77:       ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
78:       ctx.fill();
79:     }
80:   }
81: 
82:   // ---- Input handling ----
83:   const keys = {};
84:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
85:     // resume audio context on first interaction
86:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
87:     keys[e.key] = true;
88:   });
89:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
90: 
91:   // ---- Game state ----
92:   let asteroids = [];
93:   let lastSpawn = 0;
94:   const spawnInterval = 1.0; // seconds
95:   let startTime = null;
96:   let gameOver = false;
97: 
98:   function reset() {
99:     ship.x = 80;
100:     ship.y = canvas.height / 2;
101:     asteroids = [];
102:     lastSpawn = 0;
103:     startTime = null;
104:     gameOver = false;
105:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
106:   }
107: 
108:   function update(dt) { // update background stars and stars field
109:   // move stars leftward to simulate parallax
110:   stars.forEach(star => {
111:     star.x -= star.speed * dt;
112:     if (star.x < 0) {
113:       star.x = canvas.width;
114:       star.y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
115:     }
116:   });
117: 
118:     // move ship
119:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.y -= ship.speed * dt;
120:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.y += ship.speed * dt;
121:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed * dt;
122:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += ship.speed * dt;
123:     // keep inside bounds
124:     ship.x = Math.max(ship.radius, Math.min(canvas.width - ship.radius, ship.x));
125:     ship.y = Math.max(ship.radius, Math.min(canvas.height - ship.radius, ship.y));
126: 
127:     // spawn asteroids
128:     lastSpawn += dt;
129:     if (lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
130:       asteroids.push(new Asteroid());
131:       lastSpawn = 0;
132:     }
133: 
134:     // update asteroids & remove off‑screen
135:     asteroids.forEach(a => a.update(dt));
136:     asteroids = asteroids.filter(a => !a.isOffScreen());
137: 
138:     // collision detection (circle vs circle)
139:     for (const a of asteroids) {
140:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
141:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
142:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
143:       if (dist < a.r + ship.radius) {
144:         gameOver = true;
145:         // play crash sound
146:         playBeep(80, 0.3);
147:         break;
148:       }
149:     }
150:   }
151: 
152:   function draw() { // draw background with stars and starfield
153:     // fill space background with nebula gradient
154:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
155:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
156:     // draw stars
157:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ccc';
158:     stars.forEach(star => {
159:       ctx.beginPath();
160:       ctx.arc(star.x, star.y, star.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
161:       ctx.fill();
162:     });
163:     // draw ship (triangle pointing right)
164:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0';
165:     ctx.beginPath();
166:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x - ship.radius, ship.y - ship.radius);
167:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x - ship.radius, ship.y + ship.radius);
168:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.radius, ship.y);
169:     ctx.closePath();
170:     ctx.fill();
171:     // draw asteroids
172:     asteroids.forEach(a => a.draw());
173:     // draw score
174:     const elapsed = ((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
175:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
176:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
177:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${elapsed}s`, 10, 20);
178:     // draw game over overlay
179:     if (gameOver) {
180:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
181:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
182:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
183:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
184:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
185:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
186:       ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
187:       ctx.fillText(`Survived ${elapsed}s`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 20);
188:     }
189:   }
190:   }
191: 
192:   let lastTime = 0;
193:   function loop(timestamp) {
194:     if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
195:     const dt = (timestamp - lastTime) / 1000; // seconds
196:     lastTime = timestamp;
197:     if (!gameOver) {
198:       update(dt);
199:     }
200:     draw();
201:     if (!gameOver) {
202:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
203:     } else {
204:       // restart on any key press
205:       window.addEventListener('keydown', () => reset(), { once: true });
206:     }
207:   }
208: 
209:   // start the game
210:   reset();
211: })();
